verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor (CPU and NPU silicon). Setting up autonomous background automations is a software or OS feature, not something a chip ships. The evidence covers only hardware specs, availability, and model-deployment SDKs, with nothing showing the product itself offers user automations, so this axis is a category error for this kind of product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
